final: SELECT o.orderbase, AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_units_filled, COUNT(*) as group_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orderexecutions oe2 JOIN orders o2 ON oe2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) as proportion FROM orderexecutions oe JOIN orders o ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase ORDER BY o.orderbase
